CustomField.description: How many columns of the parent section's grid this question occupies. Default 1. Set to 2 (or higher) when a question's input needs to fill multiple grid columns — e.g. a `lightning-input-address` compound that doesn't shrink gracefully into half a grid.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Columns the question spans within its section. Default 1. Use 2 to fill a 2-column section row, 3 to fill a 3-column row.
CustomField.label: Column Span
